To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

evidence based clinical practice for rare disease is difficult due to rarity of the disease, small study populations, limited knowledge of natural history, difficulty in recruiting participants, difficulties to achieve a correct diagnosis, and difficulties in identifying patients in health information system.

the main barriers faced when conducting clinical research in the context of rare diseases are: (1) difficulty in recruiting patients because of rarity, (2) scattering of patients, (3) limited knowledge on the natural history of diseases (4) difficulties to achieve accurate diagnoses and identify patients in the health information systems, (5) difficulties in choosing clinically relevant outcomes.

the barriers to evidence-based clinical practice in rare diseases are the rarity, the scattering of patients, difficulties to achieve an accurate diagnosis, and the lack of knowledge about the natural history of diseases.
